shorthand.description: When column is in first major section (.0), it can be omitted

rules.description: When wires cross with a dot, they are electrically connected

rules.rule: Perpendicular crossings without dots are NOT connections
rules.description: When wires cross at 90 degrees without a dot, they pass over/under without connecting

slave_sequence.note: Do NOT assume slaves are numbered sequentially

training_tips: Always verify the full index format, including section, sheet, and column
Pay attention to shorthand notation - missing .Y means it's .0
When tracing wires, look carefully for connection dots
Count modules carefully - verify total against expected configuration
